claim: Letterbox is aspect change used as a dramatic device rather than a delivery format - bars sliding in to say this moment is bigger than the rest of the film. Dynamic_widen is the version that performs the change on screen.
not_visual: Bars are a composite drawn over the finished frame in ffmpeg, not something the generator produces. Animagine cannot be asked for a 2.39 bar as distinct from a 2:1 bar, and dynamic_widen is an animated change with no single-frame state.
